changelog:
- Initial release of voice-cloning skill.
- Supports creating a custom voice by either cloning from a user's audio sample or designing from a natural-language description.
- Integrates with multiple models: Qwen3-TTS (for cloning and custom voices), Dia (for multi-speaker/dialogue), and Qwen VoiceDesign (for bespoke voices).
- Handles consent requirements for cloning real voices.
- Guides users on preparing quality reference samples and descriptions.
- Recommends best practices for generating consistent and high-quality custom voice outputs.
summary: Create a custom voice and speak text in it. Use when the user says "clone my voice", "make it sound like this recording", "use my voice for the narration", "...
